title: ÑAWPAQ PACHA: open-source one-month-ahead vegetation fire risk forecasting and bilingual alerts for the Peruvian Andes
description: Open-source Python pipeline that downloads public satellite and climate data (NASA FIRMS, NASA POWER, MODIS, Copernicus DEM), forecasts one month ahead the probability of at least one active-fire detection in each of the 108 districts of Puno, Peru, and publishes risk levels, plain-language reasons and Spanish/Quechua recommendations in a static web dashboard.

creators.name: Yanarico Huanca, Flor Melany
creators.affiliation: Universidad Nacional del Altiplano, Puno, Peru
